curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Reaching the pinnacle of British political power carried severe consequences—what did decades at the helm ultimately cost Margaret Thatcher in private?
curatedMovie.description: Directed by Phyllida Lloyd, this historical drama examines the life of former British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, tracing her ascent through UK politics and weighing the personal toll demanded by decades in power.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A slow, emotionally heavy biographical drama suited for an engaged, thoughtful evening alone.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Lloyd crafts an intimate, somber historical study that swaps political pageantry for a reflective look at leadership and personal sacrifice.
